results.title: Fed interest rate decision April 2026: Fed holds rates steady amid dissent
Federal Reserve Board - Implementation Note issued April 29, 2026
US Fed holds rates steady, Powell to remain on its board | Business and Economy
What Does the Fed's April Rate Decision Signal for 2026?

summary: FOMC held rates at 3.5%-3.75% on April 29, 2026 (Powell's likely final meeting as Chair). Unusual 8-4 split. Inflation remains elevated above 2% target due to tariffs and energy prices. Markets pricing NO cuts for rest of 2026 and into 2027.
